Duplicate sign conflict: DocumentAuditFactsModal previously continued displaying sign button even when document was already cryptographically signed (causing 409 conflict); now resolved with verified official blue seal.

Prescription stamp divergence: PrescriptionSheetPreview previously used an ad-hoc custom blue box instead of GOST R 7.0.97-2016 standard stamp; now aligned with double border, shield, standard wording and PT Astra Sans font.
Doctor autonomy & PIN friction: cryptoPro.ts did not forward programmatic PIN to CAdESCOM.CPSigner; now supports propset_KeyPin for quiet single-unlock smartcard sessions.
Zero-mock detached upload: useCryptoProSigning previously accepted any arbitrary string or file; now strictly validates ASN.1 SEQUENCE (0x30) and 64+ byte minimum container length.
